description: This file defines string constants for different trace categories (Constructor, Destructor, Copy Constructor, Assignment Operator) within the Thunder::Trace namespace. It also conditionally includes a header for trace factory functionality on Windows.

classes.name: Constructor
classes.description: Represents a trace category for constructor calls, containing a static string _text.

classes.name: Destructor
classes.description: Represents a trace category for destructor calls, containing a static string _text.

classes.name: CopyConstructor
classes.description: Represents a trace category for copy constructor calls, containing a static string _text.

classes.name: AssignmentOperator
classes.description: Represents a trace category for assignment operator calls, containing a static string _text.

methods.name: CopyConstructor::_text
methods.description: Static string initialized to 'Copy Constructor called'.

methods.name: AssignmentOperator::_text
methods.description: Static string initialized to 'Assignment Operator called'.

ctags.name: _text
ctags.pattern: /^    \/* static *\/ const string AssignmentOperator::_text(_T("Assignment Operator called"));$/

ctags.name: _text
ctags.pattern: /^    \/* static *\/ const string CopyConstructor::_text(_T("Copy Constructor called"));$/
